elements_selected.content: Create src/web/context.rs with Serde-serializable structs for template data: VaultContext, PageEntry, StatsContext, ZetlMeta, BreadcrumbEntry, BacklinkEntry, OutlinkEntry, PageContext, FolderContext, SubfolderEntry. Each struct derives Serialize. PageContext.frontmatter is serde_json::Value (empty object {} for now — actual parsing is Phase 4). Add builder functions that convert VaultData + page-specific data into these context structs. Export the module from src/web/mod.rs. See SPEC-012 §3.5 for exact struct definitions.
